card.name: Spaces before dose amounts in tables
card.fires_on: A blank space right before a dose number such as 4 g fat/kg/day or 0.5 to 1 g/kg, mostly in dosing tables and age-based dose lines. Also seen inside the long chemical name 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl.

modes.label: Space before dose
modes.description: The space token just before a per-kilogram dose figure in a dosing table or limit statement.

modes.label: Inside HMG name
modes.description: Partway through the chemical name 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-coenzyme A.
